details.effect: [fanfare] Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Goblinoid card from among them and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. [act] [engage], banish 3 Goblinoid cards from your cemetery: Select an enemy follower on the field. Destroy it and deal 3 damage to its leader.

issues: Remove keywords entries for "fanfare" and "act"; these are timings and should only be represented as abilities, not in keywords.

The activated ability should use a single selected enemy follower for both clauses; encode it as destroying the selected enemy follower and dealing 3 damage to that follower's leader with a linked effect such as damageFollowerAndLeader, not as separate destroy-any-follower plus 3 damage to enemy leader.

details.effect: [evolve][cost00]: Evolve this follower. Ward. [fanfare] Deal 2 damage to each other follower on your field.

issues: The fanfare is targeted incorrectly: it should deal 2 damage to each other follower on your field, not to each enemy follower. Replace dealDamageAllEnemies with dealDamageOtherFollowers or an equivalent self-field-only effect excluding this follower.
Remove "evolve" and "fanfare" from keywords; they are timings/evolve metadata, not keywords.
